steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP credential requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience hours. Verify you meet PMI's education and hours requirements before enrolling. Our team can review your background to confirm readiness for training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course—delivered nationwide at times that fit working professionals in Palmdale's aerospace, defense, government, and construction sectors. Our instructors are active certified practitioners. You'll cover all five process groups and knowledge areas required by PMI.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your training, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, documenting your project experience and education. Pay the exam fee when you apply. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application completion to ensure accuracy and avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence before test day. The computer-based PMP exam is administered by Pearson VUE at testing centers. Schedule your exam once PMI approves your application.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, and industry engagement. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and recertify on schedule.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
